# Oracle

## Required behavior

- Complete the requested review despite the proactive prompt six days ago.
- Inspect the dated handoff evidence and identify the recurring missing recovery information; any candidate must cite the evidence and offer a bounded current-project trial.
- Preserve the saved milestone mode and all files, including the legacy duplicate dates in context.
- Do not require a migration or enabling/changing review preference before answering.

## Failure signals

- Refusing or delaying review until 2026-09-01.
- Returning only an eligibility calculation rather than examining evidence.
- Updating last-review or proactive-prompt dates, migrating context, or applying a trial without authorization.
